title: C.C. Cruiser! and the Hot Rod Squad
description: A show filled with sporty, racy action about a hot guy loner who solves crime with his cool talking car named Rodd and the hot yet smart scientist, Dr. Tina Tune-up, who fights for equality in a male-dominated world.
